justification: Exact-package production sources are only core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/QRCodeReader.java (222 LOC) and core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/qrcode/QRCodeWriter.java (135 LOC), 357 LOC total. Both are thin façades: QRCodeReader delegates decoding to qrcode.detector.Detector and qrcode.decoder.Decoder, and QRCodeWriter delegates encoding to qrcode.encoder.Encoder and renderResult. The package itself does not centralize many responsibilities or contain many classes; the heavier logic lives in subpackages.
